feed.deadline_reason: Update now: from Mon 23 Nov 00:00 UTC this release stops following the chain.

releases.notes:
This update is needed before Mon 23 Nov 00:00 UTC, when validators start agreeing each day's TDH on the 6529 chain. Validators on older releases stop following the chain then.

- Transaction fees drop to a hundredth from Mon 23 Nov.
- Validators read Ethereum until 15 January 2027, and the "update by" note is gone.
- Automatic updates download every release within 30 minutes.
- Today speaks for your account when it has more than one validator.
- A validator whose TDH day differs from the network's keeps its peers.
- Fixes: Tor no longer reads "Blocked" next to "All good", the page no longer says the service is not answering after it came up, and Linux gives back memory after the daily computation.

Nothing to do if auto-update is on.
releases.reason: Needed before daily TDH moves onto the chain at Mon 23 Nov 00:00 UTC. Validators without it stop following the chain then.

releases.notes: This update fixes what some pages say about your chain seat, and how the Mac app starts the validator.
This update brings the backup block maker, which the 6529 chain turns on at Fri 20 Nov 00:00 UTC, and frees validators…
This update lets the 6529 chain take in TDH days from Tue 17 Nov 20:00 UTC.
New and returning validators now start from a checkpoint of the 6529 chain that comes with the release.
Transfers and chain authorizations work again on the main network.
The 6529 chain moves to new rules on 17 November; only this release follows them.
Chain votes from validators behind sentries now reach the network, which the chain needs to finalize.
This release starts the 6529 chain, with the test currency $fake6529.
rc.15 checks an automatic update through its first day's vote.
rc.14 installs updates by itself.
rc.13 is a regular update: install it when it suits you.
Fixes validators that join the new chain for the first time: they could not load the network's history.
rc.11 fixes installing and updating on Windows set to a language other than English, such as Spanish.
rc.10 runs Sunday's switch exactly as rc.9 does.
Signed TDH starts again on Sunday 8 November, 00:00 UTC, with the zero and dead addresses in the total.
The fourth release for testers.
The third release for testers.
The second release for testers.
The first release for testers.
